build_conversational_entity: build a conversational agent prefab with engaging dialogue dynamics using Entity.build with a language model and memory bank
configure_entity_params: configure the Entity prefab params to set agent name and optional conversation style before building
review_conversation_dynamics_question: review the CONVERSATION_DYNAMICS_QUESTION template that guides converge versus diverge strategy for micro-topics
inspect_entity_components: inspect the agent components including situation perception, self perception, last sentence, and relevant memories used by Entity
customize_conversation_style: customize the Entity prefab by passing a conversation_style param to inject a constant conversation style component
